# Alerts and channels

An alert is a rule sent to one or more channels: `instant`, `hourly`, `daily` or `weekly` (daily and weekly need a `schedule` with an hour and a timezone). Slack and Telegram channels are connected in the dashboard; email and webhook channels can be created here. A webhook's secret is shown once, when it is created. A rule sends relevant mentions only unless its filter's `minRelevance` goes under the line. Tests and runs send for real, so use them only when the user asks.

Base URL `https://api.rumoro.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $RUMORO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. Each endpoint names its `rumoro` CLI command for when the CLI is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /v1/alerts/{id}`: Get an alert

Returns one alert with its filter, mode, schedule, channels and delivery stats.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:get`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `filter`, `schedule`, `event`, `channels`, `stats`, `createdAt`: The requested alert.

### `PATCH /v1/alerts/{id}`: Update an alert

Changes an alert. `filter` and `channelIds` replace the old values. Queued digests are cancelled, as are queued sends to a removed channel or from a disabled alert.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:update`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `mode` | `instant`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly` |  |  |
| `filter` | object |  | Sets the full new filter. |
| `filter.keywordIds` | string[] |  | Limits the rule to these keywords. |
| `filter.groupIds` | string[] |  | Limits the rule to keywords in these groups (grp_...), for example one rule for each client. |
| `filter.platforms` | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Limits the rule to posts from these platforms. |
| `filter.minRelevance` | integer |  | The lowest relevance score the rule sends. Without it, only relevant mentions are sent, meaning a score of 40 or more. A lower value, down to 0, also sends matches the classifier rated as noise. A higher value sends fewer. Email channels always use 40, whatever the rule says. Mentions without a score are never sent. |
| `filter.minConfidence` | number |  | Sends only mentions whose classifier confidence is this value or higher, from 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are left out. |
| `filter.sentiments` | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Keeps mentions with these sentiments only. |
| `filter.intents` | string[] |  | Sends only mentions with one or more of these intent or topic tags. |
| `filter.excludeAuthors` | string[] |  | Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links. |
| `filter.minFollowers` | integer |  | Sends only posts by authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `filter.tags` | string[] |  | Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags. |
| `filter.linkHosts` | string[] |  | Sends only posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains, so slack.com also matches api.slack.com. Posts without links are left out. |
| `filter.languages` | string[] |  | Sends only posts in these languages, as ISO 639-1 codes such as en, es or de. Posts with an unknown language are left out. |
| `filter.automated` | boolean |  | true sends only posts that look machine-made, such as bot or template posts. false sends only the others. Leave it out to send both. |
| `filter.ratings` | integer[] |  | Sends only reviews with one of these star ratings, from 1 to 5. Use [1, 2] for the unhappy ones. Posts that are not reviews are left out. |
| `filter.notRatings` | integer[] |  | Star ratings (1 to 5) to skip, such as [5]. Other posts still go out. |
| `filter.minLikes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out. |
| `filter.minReposts` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out. |
| `filter.minReplies` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out. |
| `filter.minQuotes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out. |
| `filter.minViews` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out. |
| `filter.minBookmarks` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out. |
| `filter.anyOf` | object[] |  | Up to 10 OR'd groups (at least 1). A mention must meet every condition of some group, plus all other conditions, so the filter reads (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). Groups take view filter fields (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists and so on) but no nested anyOf. |
| `schedule` | object or null |  | For daily and weekly alerts. An hourly alert ignores it, but refuses a weekday. |
| `schedule.hour` | integer | yes |  |
| `schedule.minute` | integer |  |  |
| `schedule.timezone` | string | yes |  |
| `schedule.skipEmpty` | boolean |  |  |
| `schedule.weekday` | integer |  | The day a weekly rule sends, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. Required when mode is weekly and ignored for daily rules. |
| `event` | string or null |  |  |
| `channelIds` | string[] |  | Sets the full new list. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `filter`, `schedule`, `event`, `channels`, `stats`, `createdAt`: The alert after the change.

### `DELETE /v1/alerts/{id}`: Delete an alert

Deletes the alert and its delivery history. Its channels stay.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:delete`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Answers `204`: Done.

### `GET /v1/alerts`: List alerts

Lists the workspace's alerts, latest first, each with its filter, mode, schedule and channels.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:list`

Answers `200` with `data`: All of the workspace's alerts, latest first.

### `POST /v1/alerts`: Create an alert

Creates an alert, which pairs a filter with one or more channels. instant mode sends each matching mention as it arrives. hourly sends a digest of the previous full UTC hour at five past, skips hours with no mention above the rule's minimum, takes no schedule and works with Slack, Telegram and webhook channels only. daily sends one digest at schedule.hour in schedule.timezone. weekly sends one a week on schedule.weekday, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. filter.anyOf adds OR logic with groups of mention-list conditions. At least one group must match, as well as the rest of the filter.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:create`

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `mode` | `instant`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly` |  |  |
| `filter` | object |  |  |
| `filter.keywordIds` | string[] |  | Limits the rule to these keywords. |
| `filter.groupIds` | string[] |  | Limits the rule to keywords in these groups (grp_...), for example one rule for each client. |

| `filter.minRelevance` | integer |  | The lowest relevance score the rule sends. Without it, only relevant mentions are sent, meaning a score of 40 or more. A lower value, down to 0, also sends matches the classifier rated as noise. A higher value sends fewer. Email channels always use 40, whatever the rule says. Mentions without a score are never sent. |
| `filter.minConfidence` | number |  | Sends only mentions whose classifier confidence is this value or higher, from 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are left out. |
| `filter.sentiments` | list of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` |  | Keeps mentions with these sentiments only. |
| `filter.intents` | string[] |  | Sends only mentions with one or more of these intent or topic tags. |
| `filter.excludeAuthors` | string[] |  | Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links. |
| `filter.minFollowers` | integer |  | Sends only posts by authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out. |
| `filter.tags` | string[] |  | Keeps authors your workspace gave one of these tags. |
| `filter.linkHosts` | string[] |  | Sends only posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains, so slack.com also matches api.slack.com. Posts without links are left out. |
| `filter.languages` | string[] |  | Sends only posts in these languages, as ISO 639-1 codes such as en, es or de. Posts with an unknown language are left out. |
| `filter.automated` | boolean |  | true sends only posts that look machine-made, such as bot or template posts. false sends only the others. Leave it out to send both. |
| `filter.ratings` | integer[] |  | Sends only reviews with one of these star ratings, from 1 to 5. Use [1, 2] for the unhappy ones. Posts that are not reviews are left out. |
| `filter.notRatings` | integer[] |  | Star ratings (1 to 5) to skip, such as [5]. Other posts still go out. |
| `filter.minLikes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out. |
| `filter.minReposts` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out. |
| `filter.minReplies` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out. |
| `filter.minQuotes` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out. |
| `filter.minViews` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out. |
| `filter.minBookmarks` | integer |  | Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out. |
| `filter.anyOf` | object[] |  | Up to 10 OR'd groups (at least 1). A mention must meet every condition of some group, plus all other conditions, so the filter reads (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). Groups take view filter fields (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists and so on) but no nested anyOf. |
| `schedule` | object |  | Daily and weekly alerts need it, and weekly ones need schedule.weekday too. Hourly alerts send every UTC hour, ignore a time or zone, and reject a weekday. |
| `schedule.hour` | integer | yes |  |
| `schedule.minute` | integer |  |  |
| `schedule.timezone` | string | yes |  |
| `schedule.skipEmpty` | boolean |  |  |
| `schedule.weekday` | integer |  | The day a weekly rule sends, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. Required when mode is weekly and ignored for daily rules. |
| `event` | string or null |  | Custom webhook event name. Null keeps the mode's default. |
| `channelIds` | string[] |  | Where to send, as ids from GET /v1/channels. |

Answers `201` with `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `filter`, `schedule`, `event`, `channels`, `stats`, `createdAt`: The new alert.

### `POST /v1/alerts/{id}/test`: Test an alert

Sends a test message to each of the alert's channels now and returns each outcome. Webhooks receive the event `test`.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:test`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Answers `200` with `outcomes`: A test was tried on each of the alert's channels.

### `POST /v1/alerts/{id}/run`: Send a digest now

Sends the digest for the alert's last hour, day or week now and returns each channel's outcome. Works on digest alerts only, and the schedule doesn't change.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:run`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Answers `200` with `skipped`, `matched`, `relevant`, `outcomes`: Sent now for the alert's last hour, day or week. The scheduled digest is unaffected.

### `POST /v1/alerts/{id}/mute`: Mute authors

Adds authors to the alert's muted list and leaves the rest of its filter alone. Links are handled as in the dashboard, so a post link mutes its author, twitter.com turns into x.com and a Hacker News profile keeps its id. Authors who are already muted are skipped, so retrying is safe. An entry that is not a person, such as a subreddit or a story, fails the request and the error names it.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:mute`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authors` | string[] | yes | A profile link (x.com/name, linkedin.com/in/name, reddit.com/user/name), post link, handle (@name, u/name), Bluesky DID or display name. Links are stored as the author's profile. A bare name or handle covers every platform. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `filter`, `schedule`, `event`, `channels`, `stats`, `createdAt`: Updated alert with the new muted list.

### `POST /v1/alerts/{id}/unmute`: Unmute authors

Takes authors off the muted list, keeping the rest of the filter. Each entry can be the stored value or any link to the person's profile or posts. Retrying is safe, because authors who aren't muted are skipped.

CLI: `rumoro alerts:unmute`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The alert's id (feed_...). |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authors` | string[] | yes | A profile link (x.com/name, linkedin.com/in/name, reddit.com/user/name), post link, handle (@name, u/name), Bluesky DID or display name. Links are stored as the author's profile. A bare name or handle covers every platform. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `mode`, `filter`, `schedule`, `event`, `channels`, `stats`, `createdAt`: Updated alert with the new muted list.

### `GET /v1/channels/{id}`: Get a channel

Returns one channel with its settings, account events and delivery stats. A webhook's signing secret is never shown here.

CLI: `rumoro channels:get`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |

Answers `200`: The requested channel.

### `PATCH /v1/channels/{id}`: Update a channel

Changes a channel's label and account events, and a webhook's URL and headers. `headers` and `events` replace the old values.

CLI: `rumoro channels:update`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string |  |  |
| `url` | string |  | For webhook channels only. |
| `headers` | object |  | For webhook channels only. Sets the full new set of headers. |
| `events` | list of `keyword.capped`, `keyword.paused_for_balance`, `keyword.resumed`, `wallet.low`, `wallet.paused`, `wallet.resumed`, `mention.spike`, `sentiment.negative_spike`, `keyword.noisy`, `channel.failing` |  | Sets the full list of account events the channel gets. A webhook can take any of them. Slack, email and Telegram channels take only the attention events (mention.spike, sentiment.negative_spike, keyword.noisy, channel.failing). An empty list turns them all off. |

Answers `200`: The channel after the change.

### `DELETE /v1/channels/{id}`: Delete a channel

Deletes the channel and takes it off its alerts. Queued sends to it are cancelled. The alerts stay.

CLI: `rumoro channels:delete`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |

Answers `204`: Done.

### `POST /v1/channels/{id}/test`: Test a channel

Sends a test message to the channel now and returns the outcome. Webhooks receive the event `test`.

CLI: `rumoro channels:test`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |

Answers `200` with `outcomes`: Test attempt made. Webhooks receive event "test".

### `POST /v1/channels/{id}/rotate-secret`: Rotate the signing secret

Gives a webhook channel a new signing secret, shown only in this response. The old secret stops working at once.

CLI: `rumoro channels:rotate-secret`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |

Answers `200`: The new signing secret, shown only now. The old one stops working right away..

### `GET /v1/channels/{id}/deliveries`: List a channel's deliveries

Lists the mentions, digests and account events sent to the channel, latest first, with status and the last error. `limit` defaults to 50, up to 200.

CLI: `rumoro channels:deliveries`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The channel's id (dest_...). |
| `limit` | query | integer |  |  |

Answers `200` with `data`: Everything sent to the channel, latest first, including instant mentions and digests, with status and the last error.

### `GET /v1/channels`: List channels

Lists the workspace's channels with their settings and delivery stats.

CLI: `rumoro channels:list`

Answers `200` with `data`: All of the workspace's channels.

### `POST /v1/channels`: Create a channel

Creates a webhook (the default), email or Slack channel. Slack needs a connected workspace, otherwise 409. Telegram chats are connected in the dashboard. A webhook's signing secret appears only in this response.

CLI: `rumoro channels:create`

Answers `201`: Created. For a webhook this is the only time the signing secret is shown..
